And that's it.

Have fun!

notes.title: Update to 1.1
notes.content:
Hey!

Today we bring you an update for "Fiery Disaster" to version 1.1.

There is only one change but, in our opinion, quite serious.

Secret mode is not secret anymore - Zombie Mode, unlocked after beating Campaign Mode before, is now unlocked from the start.

Less thinking, more clicking!

Have fun!

Best,
Maciej

notes.title: Version 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hello!

Today we've updated "Fiery Disaster" to version 1.0.2:

- Really rare but critical error involving Engineers fixed
- Fixed bug disallowing to change control buttons after the game was minimized  with ALT+TAB
- Small tweaks with leaderboards

Have fun!

Best,
Maciej

notes.title: Linux Version and Update to V 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

Today we're releasing "Fiery Disaster" for Linux! Woo hoo!

Also, we are making a small update to version 1.0.1:
- English version showed Polish "Porażka" instead of "Failed" and the other way around - that's fixed
- Fixed few typos in the story
- Every button in the menu makes "click" now
- Minor tweaks in GUI and graphics
- Gate Repairs have been given appropriate values in the Editor


Have fun!

Maciej
